hotspots.name: The Circle
hotspots.description: The Corpse Cathedral was built for exactly this and has been waiting.

hotspots.name: The Genie
hotspots.description: It grants what you ask for and not what you meant, and everybody who has ever dealt with one knew that going in. What you need is to be dead.

hotspots.name: A Customer Calling It In
hotspots.description: Three years a customer, never once asking for anything he could not have got elsewhere at a worse price, establishing patiently that he is the sort of man a Fool takes a call from.

hotspots.name: The Man You Let Out
hotspots.description: Four hundred years sealed in a town where nothing happened, eleven months out of it, and a claim on the seat above the grey fog with the argument to go with it.

locked.reason: Not until the wish is paid.
